title: New major hospital, Brisbane: helipad
workplace: New major hospital with a hospital tower, two level basement and rooftop helipad, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Rooftop helipad
swms.task: Erect the rooftop helipad steel frame and deck at the roof edge, with steel lifted by the crane company's mobile crane, working more than 2 m above the roof.

facts.fallControl: Edge protection is fixed around the roof and helipad edges before the deck is laid, and openings in the deck are covered as they are formed.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection was considered for every task, and an elevating work platform where edge protection cannot be fixed.
facts.erectionSequence: Steel is erected to the designer's sequence on drawing HP-020 (revision B), with temporary bracing as shown, and the steel erection engineer checks the structure is stable before the crane slings are released.

steps: Work with the crane crew during lifts
Lift and land steel with the crane company
Erect and connect steel at height
Build the helipad at the roof edge
